General informations

  1. All communication will take place though our Discord server.
  2. The competition starts on Friday, March 15th at 6pm and ends on Sunday at 1:30pm.
  3. The puzzle hero will be closed from 9pm to 8am.
  4. A dynamic point system is used for all challenges (i.e., the more solved a challenge has, the fewer points it will be worth).
  5. Any critical information regarding the competition will be communication via Discord.

General rules

  1. Have Fun!
  2. The puzzle hero is by university.
  3. Treat everyone with respect, including the organizing committee, volunteers and other participants.
  4. DoS/DDoS attacks against the infrastructure and/or challenges are stricly forbidden.
  5. The brute-force of flag submission forms is not permitted (there is nothing to guess).
  6. Brute-force against challenges Is not allowed (e.g., login brute-force, URL path, etc.), unless explicitly allowed in the challenge description.
  7. Any problems encountered with the infrastructure and/or challenges must be reported directly to the organizing committee.
  8. If you solve a challenge, submit the flag immediately. We do not tolerate the accumulation of flag5 to manipulate the performance of other participants.
  9. The use of automatic exploitation tools and mass vulnerability scanners is strictly prohibited for all challenges.
  10. Do not publish flags or solutions publicly until the puzzle hero is finished.
  11. Keep your solutions (screenshots, scripts, etc.) in case the organizers ask you to provide them.
  12. The puzzle hero organizing committee reserves the right to disqualify anyone likely to violate the CTF rules.
  13. The flag format will often be provided in the challenges, if so, please follow it (e.g., flag{...}).
  14. Rule flag #1: flag{Rul35_@re_imp0rtant}
